orientation: inside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: the core sits on the floor with its top 4px overhanging the inner wall face (see offset); cable plugs into the power coupling
notes: Concord Long-Burn Drive Mk1, a hull mount (outward is up): a long slender bell on a plate, a fuel drum with a level window on each side piped into the bell base, a pale-blue exhaust; inside the Concord core with its lights pale blue and a big fuel-efficiency dial (red, amber and green arc, a trembling needle) with level lamps. Damaged: the bell lip dented and hanging, the bell cracked and sputtering, the right drum cracked and weeping pale fuel, the dial glass cracked and its needle stuck, lamps red, sparks. Disabled: the bell bent over at the neck, a drum split and slid off, the dial dead and cracked, the repair hatch popped. THIS FILE: the INSIDE half (core, power coupling, repair hatch; its top 4px overhang the inner wall face as a flange).
